hazards.evidence: The right-hand stair rail is short and covers only the lower portion of the staircase.
Cords or wires are draped across and alongside the lower stair treads.
The staircase is dimly lit, with only a light visible at the upper landing.
The busy, low-contrast stair covering obscures step edges and appears uneven or loose in places.
A cord is stretched diagonally across the open walking area beside the stairs.
